comment: A pen press on the Brush Presets docker's grid, away from its scroll bar, and a drag up scroll the presets by the drag's length and pick none. The comment that names the virtual pen is where its suite, scripts/test_a_pen_drag_on_the_brush_presets_scrolls_them_and_picks_none.py, puts the pen's records from virtual_pen.py, turned into the driver's pen steps.
The virtual pen drags the presets up from the middle of the grid
